mbm-2476.clue: The long whistle has two short shadows.
mbm-2476.quote: At the crossing I drew the train driver's hand and its shadow as he waved. On my next visit he held up my sketch in the cab window. That time I drew two paper hands waving back.

mbm-2477.clue: My tent has a guest book.
mbm-2477.quote: I pass round a scrap of canvas for friends to draw the morning weather. I sew it inside the flap after each trip. A row of tiny clouds greets me before I unzip the tent.

mbm-2478.clue: The oldest pillow has a speaking part.
mbm-2478.quote: My sister and I watched a sailor show in pajamas and gave my lumpy pillow the captain's hat. Little cousins still bring the captain out exactly when the theme starts.

mbm-2479.clue: I found the ending on the kitchen tile.
mbm-2479.quote: My aunt lent me a book with a loose back page. It slid out while I was making tea. I put the kettle on top before I could read a word, then went back to chapter one.

mbm-2480.clue: I know which arcade button is home.
mbm-2480.quote: The start button has a shallow nick from somebody's ring. I found it with my eyes closed after three years away. The kid beside me taught me the rest of the controls.

mbm-2481.clue: I let the sparrows announce check.
mbm-2481.quote: At the park table a sparrow taps crumbs out of our little wooden clock box. When my opponent looks up I wait. Even at a minute each, a bird gets breakfast.

mbm-2482.clue: The spoon on my cup travels alone.
mbm-2482.quote: I carved a tiny wooden spoon for camp coffee and tied it to my mug. A squirrel paid me a visit and left with the spoon instead of the biscuit. Somewhere in the pines there's a very polite squirrel.

mbm-2483.clue: My little railway has a real conductor.
mbm-2483.quote: I draw train cars on envelopes while I wait at the station. My nephew lines them up on the carpet and puts a toy mouse in the front. He writes to me when he needs more carriages.

mbm-2484.quote: The rehearsal room has an old brass fish hanging by the door. Hit the right chord and its tail rattles. We hold the last note till the fish joins in.

mbm-2485.clue: My first crochet blanket fits the letterbox.
mbm-2485.quote: I started making a bedspread and got impatient after three rows. I folded the strip into a tiny envelope and mailed Gran a note inside. She sent me more yarn by return post.

mbm-2486.clue: My computer draws the weather indoors.
mbm-2486.quote: I wrote a program that turns one pixel blue each time I hear a raindrop hit the tin roof. My sister works the key. Our best picture took a whole thunderstorm and two mugs of cocoa.

mbm-2487.clue: My belt lives beside a little wooden arrow.
mbm-2487.quote: I kept stepping too far forward during a kata, so our instructor chalked an arrow on the floor. At my grading he gave me a little carved arrow. I keep it pointing back toward class.

mbm-2488.clue: The blanket has a seat number.
mbm-2488.quote: I stitched a scrap from our old van's checked seat cover into a quilt. It's surrounded by strips in road colors. Gran touches that square and knows she's got her place by the window.

mbm-2489.clue: My best game runs on a shoebox.
mbm-2489.quote: My cousin and I drew an arcade maze on a shoebox when the power failed. We played with a pea and two spoons till the lights came back. Nobody reached for the plug.

mbm-2490.clue: One of my juggling clubs can post a letter.
mbm-2490.quote: I wrapped the handle with old stamps from our family's envelopes. When it spins I catch flashes of places I haven't been. Mum wants me to catch the club in Italy next turn.

mbm-2491.clue: I dance the chorus with my coat on.
mbm-2491.quote: I used to leave the club before my bus. Then the DJ started playing my favorite chorus just as I reached the door. Half my friends learned that shuffle in their overcoats.

mbm-2492.clue: I save seats for the empty spaces.
mbm-2492.quote: My cinema notebook has little maps of the seats where we watched each film. The funny part is remembering who moved closer to whom halfway through a scary one.

mbm-2493.clue: My serves get graded in seashells.
mbm-2493.quote: My niece sits in the sand with a pail. Every serve that lands in she drops a shell into it. When the bucket rattles on the way home I know I've had a good day.

mbm-2494.clue: I framed the drip instead of the ski.
mbm-2494.quote: Dad took a photo of my first run across the wake. A drop of lake water on the lens caught a tiny upside-down picture of the boat. I gave him the frame with a magnifying glass.

mbm-2495.clue: My green patch used to be a secret door.
mbm-2495.quote: I took the flap from my childhood play tent and stitched it into a quilt. The flap still opens. My brother slid a little drawing of our old fort underneath it at Christmas.

mbm-2496.clue: The rule book has room for a recipe.
mbm-2496.quote: Our board game broke for supper in the middle of a tie. Uncle wrote his soup recipe on the blank last page. Now whenever two pieces share the finish, somebody makes soup.

mbm-2497.clue: I got a solo by missing a word.
mbm-2497.quote: I forgot one line of the chorus and hummed till I found it. My friends liked the hum so much they all dropped out on the next verse. Now that's my little solo.

mbm-2498.clue: My vase still has a thumb at the bottom.
mbm-2498.quote: I made a tall vase and forgot which way the base was turned. When I flipped it after firing, my first thumbprint was underneath. I sign all my pots that way now.

mbm-2499.clue: My coat button knows a kingfisher.
mbm-2499.quote: I sit by the creek with blue buttons on my coat. One morning a kingfisher perched beside me and every button looked dull. I tried nine blues in my notebook before breakfast.

mbm-2500.clue: There are three kinds of white in the snow.
mbm-2500.quote: Our winter quilt uses old pillowcases from three houses. Next to each other they're cream, grey and butter yellow. Under it all three kitchens feel close enough to walk between.
